lead_ceremony:
As Zapglint dreams that night, she finds herself walking the stars of Silverpelt, a ghostly landscape surrounding her and a single, starry cat sat within a clearing.

The starry cat approaches her and, although the cat is unfamiliar, their meeting still feels like a reunion with an old friend. "My name is Junipercrackle. You meet me tonight, but the cats under your care will all meet me one day when they join the stars. For now," the cat presses his nose to Zapglint's forehead, "Take this gift, to help you have the strength to overcome your fears."

Suddenly, the mist at the edge of the clearing takes shape. Dozens of wispy, starry spirits emerge, quickly surrounding Zapglint. "We grant you your remaining 8 lives." Individually, each voice is distant, but together, the force of their words shakes Zapglint to her core. "Use them well, with our blessing." And in a heartbeat, they were gone.

Zapstar wakes, her new name echoing in her ears.
